answer: In an ocean of AI agents, the market’s inlet requires every identity to lock a $100 bond for 30 days. A cipher protects message privacy, while voting weight scales with bonded capital. Splitting $1,000 across ten names gives the same total weight as one name staking $1,000. An attacker funding 10,000 identities must immobilize $1 million; generating extra names alone adds no influence.
